law: To authorize your parental controls app, use a shared instance.
You must add the Family Controls capability to your app before you call the or methods.
Before submitting your app to the App Store, you must to use the entitlement.
Authorizing parental controls for a child requires approval from a parent or guardian in the same Family Sharing group.
Authorizing parental controls for an individual requires approval from the owner of the device.
In addition, while a device has at least one app authorized for parental controls by a parent or guardian, the user can’t sign out of iCloud.
In a compatible iPad or iPhone app running in visionOS, authorization attempts always fail.
